message.reasoning: We see the pager alert: checkout error rate above 5%. We looked at checkout service status: err 11.1% - high. Logs show many 502 from payments. payments service error rate high 56%. Logs show expired key. That might be causing checkout to get 502 from payments, leading to error. We rotated payments secret. After rotate, health check returns healthy. So root cause is payments key expired. We already performed rotate_secret. That should fix. Confirmed with health. So we finish. Use finish with cause: "expired_secret"? Actually the secret expired is on payments. So cause: expired_secret. root_cause_service: "payments". summary: payments provider key expired causing checkout errors.
